title: acer subtrilobum
intro: Acer subtrilobum, commonly known as the Chinese paperbark maple, is a species of flowering plant in the family Sapindaceae. It is native to China and is known for its unique, exfoliating bark that peels off in papery layers. The health benefits of Acer subtrilobum include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Acer subtrilobum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects.
